monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement materially expands the product-neutral manual rolling-machine guide with a measured compatibility card, three-exact-system comparison, annualized device-cost formula, clean return-window acceptance test, warranty and service evidence, and explicit no-purchase outcome. It adds no seller, model recommendation, price, coupon, stock, rating, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement.

image_qa.note: The seed-and-clone guide, rolling-machine comparison, and source-integrity policy use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No seed, plant, rolling machine, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The September 28–October 25 report showed 841 impressions, four clicks, 0.476% CTR, and average position 22.477. It is three days old and usable, but no unaddressed query or editorial page had meaningful volume in the roughly position-4-to-20 band, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub (four impressions, one click, position 7) and Stem Cell CBG (19 impressions, one click, position 6) were already reinforced; About, Contact, Affiliate Disclosure, and Editorial Policy are navigational; the Montana query has two impressions; the HTTP and pre-roll rows have one impression; and Blue Dream sits mostly around positions 40–61. The report therefore prevented another overlapping CBG, generic hub, pre-roll-container, Montana, or Blue Dream article while the batch filled distinct lawful-starter, accessory-comparison, and source-integrity gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy New York seed-and-clone purchase and intake record grounded in current OCM home-cultivation guidance, seller verification, personal-home-cultivation rules, and nursery source controls. It keeps seller authority, starter type, source identity, label fields, testing limits, pesticide disclosure, known-pest assurance, delivered condition, plant count, secure placement, and rejection or destruction records separate. Reciprocal links from the home-grow planner, IPM guide, and legal-shopping path strengthen the cultivation cluster. No speculative outreach target was added and no outreach was sent.
